AnalysisMetric.description:
Operations supported by the decision intelligence module.
Rejects arbitrary or unsupported queries.

Phase 2 additions:
- OVERVIEW: snapshot-level summary (encounters, images, cameras, time coverage).
- SPECIES_ENCOUNTER_COUNTS: deduplicated encounter/species contributions.
- CAMERA_COMPARISON: per-camera/site encounter and species counts.
- DAILY_ACTIVITY: encounter counts grouped by calendar date.
- HOURLY_ACTIVITY: encounter counts grouped by hour-of-day (0-23).
- SPECIES_CAMERA_MATRIX: species × camera count matrix.
- EFFORT_NORMALISED_RATES: encounters per active camera-day.
AnalysisMetric.title: AnalysisMetric

ClockComparabilityPolicy.description:
Policy declaring the operational basis for comparing timestamps across different cameras.
- DOCUMENTED_SYNC: clocks verified synchronized across deployment (e.g. NTP, GPS, manual sync).
- ANALYST_ASSUMPTION: explicit analyst policy assuming clocks are synchronized within stated bounds.
- OFFSETS_KNOWN: clock offsets and uncertainty are known and propagated conservatively.
- UNKNOWN: inter-camera clock alignment is unverified (returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA).
ClockComparabilityPolicy.title: ClockComparabilityPolicy

InclusionPolicy.description: Policy governing which detections are admitted into analytical aggregations.
InclusionPolicy.title: InclusionPolicy

SpatialMode.description:
Spatial evaluation mode for cross-camera observation correlation (Phase 4, Feature F06).
- TIME_SPECIES_ONLY: GPS coordinates optional; spatial checks not evaluated.
- SPATIAL_WHEN_AVAILABLE: evaluates distance when coordinates exist; marks missing as unavailable.
- SPATIAL_REQUIRED: evaluates only pairs with genuine coordinates; returns UNAVAILABLE if missing.
SpatialMode.title: SpatialMode

description:
Phase 4 Request payload for cross-camera observation correlation (Feature F06).
Finds pairs of encounters from different cameras that satisfy explicit species,
temporal, and optional spatial rules.

CRITICAL INTERPRETATION:
A match means: 'Possible association between recorded sightings under the configured rules.'
It does NOT establish the same individual animal, confirmed movement, migration corridor,
travel speed, or probability of identity.

species_ids.description: Optional focal species/taxa IDs to match. None evaluates all eligible species.
species_ids.title: Species Ids

camera_ids.description: Optional set of camera IDs to include in the evaluation.
camera_ids.title: Camera Ids

site_ids.description: Optional set of site IDs to include.
site_ids.title: Site Ids

start_time.description: Start of analysis time window (must be timezone-aware).
start_time.title: Start Time

end_time.description: End of analysis time window (must be timezone-aware).
end_time.title: End Time

analysis_timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for reporting and interval localization.
analysis_timezone.title: Analysis Timezone

max_temporal_separation_seconds.description: Maximum allowable temporal separation in seconds between encounter intervals (default: 3600.0s = 1.0h). Encounters with gap <= max_temporal_separation_seconds satisfy the temporal rule. Notice: this is an unvalidated configurable heuristic, not a proven biological or travel threshold.
max_temporal_separation_seconds.title: Max Temporal Separation Seconds

clock_comparability_policy.description: Policy declaring the basis for comparing timestamps across different physical cameras. Options: documented_sync, analyst_assumption, offsets_known, unknown. When 'unknown', time-based association returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA because inter-camera clock alignment is unverified. When 'offsets_known', requires either valid per-camera clock_offsets dict (seconds, t_corrected = t_raw + offset) or timestamps_pre_corrected=True with correction_provenance. Uncertainty bounds alone do not satisfy offsets_known.

clock_uncertainty_seconds.description: Combined pairwise clock-offset uncertainty bound U_pair >= 0 in seconds between cameras (default: 0.0s). If individual cameras have per-camera clock uncertainties u_A and u_B, then U_pair = u_A + u_B. For nominal gap G, true separation lies within the possible gap range [max(0, G - U_pair), G + U_pair]. Threshold eligibility means 'possibly within window' (min_possible_gap <= max_temporal_separation_seconds).
clock_uncertainty_seconds.title: Clock Uncertainty Seconds

spatial_mode.description: Spatial rule evaluation mode: 1) time_species_only: do not require coordinates, spatial_check_status='not_evaluated'. 2) spatial_when_available: apply distance checks when coordinates exist; mark others 'unavailable'. 3) spatial_required: evaluate only pairs with valid coordinates; if none exist, returns UNAVAILABLE.

max_spatial_distance_meters.description: Optional maximum distance threshold in meters between camera traps. When configured, pairs with geodesic distance > threshold are excluded.
max_spatial_distance_meters.title: Max Spatial Distance Meters

inclusion_policy.description: Policy governing which detections within encounters are admitted.

result_limit.description: Maximum number of top-ranked associations to return (default: 50). Does NOT mark response partial.
result_limit.title: Result Limit

evaluation_limit.description: Optional upper bound on candidate pairs evaluated during simulation. When applied, bounds evaluation work, marks coverage incomplete, and sets status to PARTIAL.
evaluation_limit.title: Evaluation Limit

evaluation_policy.description: Policy governing pair candidate selection when evaluation_limit is set.
evaluation_policy.title: Evaluation Policy

expected_revision.description: Expected dataset revision for optimistic concurrency.
expected_revision.title: Expected Revision
